distribution_import_bookmarks.description: Whether to import bookmarks from the default file on first run.

distribution_import_bookmarks_from_file.description: Path to the file containing initial bookmarks to import.

distribution_make_chrome_default.description: Whether to make Chrome the system-wide default browser.

distribution_make_chrome_default_for_use.description: Whether to make Chrome the default browser for the current user.

distribution_verbose_logging.description: Enable verbose logging for distribution-specific operations.

distribution_create_all_shortcuts.description: Create desktop and menu shortcuts for Chromium.

distribution_suppress_first_run_default_.description: Suppress the prompt asking the user to make Chrome the default browser.

browser_show_home_button.description: Show the home button in the toolbar.

browser_has_seen_welcome_page.description: Whether the user has already seen the welcome page.

browser_check_default_browser.description: Whether to check if Chrome is the default browser.

search_provider_overrides_enabled.description: Whether this search provider override is active.

search_provider_favicon_url.description: URL of the search provider's favicon.

search_provider_new_tab_url.description: URL used for new tab page by the search provider.

search_provider_overrides_id.description: Internal ID for the search provider override.

search_provider_keyword.description: Keyword to identify the search provider in Chromium settings.

search_provider_name.description: User-visible name of the search provider.

search_provider_search_url.description: Template URL for search queries, with {searchTerms} placeholder.

search_provider_suggest_url.description: Template URL for search suggestions, with {searchTerms} placeholder.

search_provider_overrides_version.description: Version number for search provider overrides, incremented when overrides change.

bookmark_bar_show_on_all_tabs.description: Show the bookmark bar on all tabs.

signin_allowed_on_next_startup.description: Whether sign-in is allowed on the next startup.

autofill_profile_enabled.description: Whether to enable Autofill for profiles.

autofill_credit_card_enabled.description: Whether to enable Autofill for credit cards.

payments_can_make_payment_enabled.description: Whether the user can make payments.

safebrowsing_enabled.description: Whether to enable Safe Browsing protection.

alternate_error_pages_enabled.description: Whether to enable alternate error pages.

credentials_enable_service.description: Whether to enable the credential management service.

homepage_is_newtabpage.description: Whether the homepage should be the New Tab page.
